wargearItems.name: Tacticus Armour
effects: With the exclusion of the Scouts and Centurions units, all Adeptus Astartes Infantry models are equipped with Tacticus Armour by default and possess the Tacticus keyword.
wargearItems.effectsHtml: With the exclusion of the Scouts and Centurions units, all Adeptus Astartes Infantry models are equipped with Tacticus Armour by default and possess the Tacticus keyword.

wargearItems.name: Phobos Armour
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
• Increase Movement characteristic by 1"
  • Increase Initiative characteristic by 1
  • Reduce Wounds characteristic by 1
  • Add the Scout 7" ability
  • Add the Infiltrator ability

wargearItems.name: Gravis Armour
effects: Models equipped with Gravis armour must be on a 40mm base
Cannot be Embarked in a Transport with a Toughness characteristic of 11 or less
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
• Increase Toughness characteristic by 1
  • Reduce Initiative characteristic by 1
  • Reduce Movement characteristic by 1"
  • Gain the Implacable ability
  • Models equipped with Gravis armour must be on a 40mm base
  • Cannot be Embarked in a Transport with a Toughness characteristic of 11 or less

wargearItems.name: Terminator Armour
effects: Models must be on a 40mm to 60mm base
Cannot be Embarked in a Transport with a Toughness characteristic of 11 or less
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
• Increase Strength characteristic by 1
  • Increase Toughness characteristic by 1
  • Reduce Movement characteristic by 1"
  • Increase Wounds characteristic by 1
  • Reduce Initiative characteristic by 1
  • Increase Armour Save characteristic to 2+
  • Gain the Implacable ability
  • Gain the Invulnerable Save 5+ ability
  • Gain the Deep Strike ability
  • Models must be on a 40mm to 60mm base
  • Cannot be Embarked in a Transport with a Toughness characteristic of 11 or less

wargearItems.name: Saturnine Terminator Armour
effects: Models equipped with Saturnine Terminator armour must be on a 50mm to 60mm base
Models cannot be Embarked in a Transport
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
• Increase Strength characteristic by 2
  • Increase Toughness characteristic by 3
  • Increase Wounds characteristic by 3
  • Reduce Movement characteristic by 1"
  • Reduce Initiative characteristic by 2
  • Increase Armour Save characteristic to 2+
  • Gain the Implacable ability
  • Gain the Invulnerable Save 5+ ability
  • Gain the Deep Strike ability
  • Models equipped with Saturnine Terminator armour must be on a 50mm to 60mm base
  • Models cannot be Embarked in a Transport

wargearItems.name: Scout Armour
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
• Increase Movement characteristic by 1"
  • Reduce Strength characteristic by 1
  • Reduce Toughness characteristic by 1
  • Reduce Wounds characteristic by 1
  • Reduce Armour Save characteristic to 4+
  • Add the Scout 7" ability
  • Add the Infiltrator ability

wargearItems.name: Grav Inhibitors
effects: Cannot be deployed in or embark in a Transport
Can only be selected by models equipped with Tacticus Armour or Gravis Armour
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
The bearer:

  • Increase its Movement characteristic to 10"
  • Gains the Deep Strike ability
  • Gains the Hover ability.
  • Cannot be deployed in or embark in a Transport
  • Can only be selected by models equipped with Tacticus Armour or Gravis Armour

wargearItems.name: Jump Pack
effects: Cannot be deployed in or embark in a Transport
Can only be equipped with weapons that include Jump Pack under its "Weapon Availability for Armour and Wargear" information.
Can only be selected by models equipped with Tacticus Armour or Gravis Armour
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
The bearer:

  • Increase its Movement characteristic to 12"
  • Gains the Deep Strike ability
  • Gains the Jump Pack keyword.
  • Cannot be deployed in or embark in a Transport
  • Can only be equipped with weapons that include Jump Pack under its "Weapon Availability for Armour and Wargear" information.
  • Can only be selected by models equipped with Tacticus Armour or Gravis Armour

wargearItems.name: Bike
effects: Is equipped with a Twin-linked Boltgun
Must be on a 90mm x 52mm oval base or similar
Is only eligible to be equipped with a Bike if they possess the Tacticus keyword
Can only be equipped with weapons that include Bike under its "Weapon Availability for Armour and Wargear" information.
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
The bearer:

  • Increases its Movement characteristic to 12"
  • Increases its Toughness characteristic by 1
  • Increases its Wounds characteristic by 1
  • Gains the Mounted keyword
  • Is equipped with a Twin-linked Boltgun
  • Must be on a 90mm x 52mm oval base or similar
  • Is only eligible to be equipped with a Bike if they possess the Tacticus keyword
  • Can only be equipped with weapons that include Bike under its "Weapon Availability for Armour and Wargear" information.

wargearItems.name: Artificer Armour
effects: Increases its Armour Save characteristic to 2+
Gains the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
Gains the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against Psychic attacks and [Psychic] abilities.
Can only be equipped by a model equipped with Tacticus Armour or Gravis Armour
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
The bearer:

  • Increases its Wounds characteristic by 1
  • Increases its Armour Save characteristic to 2+
  • Gains the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
  • Gains the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against Psychic attacks and [Psychic] abilities.
  • Can only be equipped by a model equipped with Tacticus Armour or Gravis Armour

wargearItems.name: Riever Gear
effects: A unit equipped with Phobos Armour or Scout Armour can be equipped with Riever Gear, which adds the following abilities:
Grapnel Launcher: Each time the bearer completes a Move, Fall Back or Charge and Fight action, ignore any vertical distance when determining the total distance the bearer can be moved.
Riever Grav-chute: Gain the Deep Strike ability.

Terror Troops (Aura): While an enemy unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) is within 3" of one or more models with this ability, subtract 1 from the Leadership characteristic of models in that enemy unit.
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
A unit equipped with Phobos Armour or Scout Armour can be equipped with Riever Gear, which adds the following abilities:

  • Grapnel Launcher: Each time the bearer completes a Move, Fall Back or Charge and Fight action, ignore any vertical distance when determining the total distance the bearer can be moved.
  • Riever Grav-chute: Gain the Deep Strike ability.
  • Terror Troops (Aura): While an enemy unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) is within 3" of one or more models with this ability, subtract 1 from the Leadership characteristic of models in that enemy unit.

wargearItems.name: Occulus
effects: Model equipped with a Boltgun, Bolt Rifle or Heavy Bolt Rifle only. The bearer's weapon gains the Precision keyword.
wargearItems.effectsHtml: Model equipped with a Boltgun, Bolt Rifle or Heavy Bolt Rifle only. The bearer's weapon gains the Precision keyword.

wargearItems.name: Camo Cloak
effects: Models equipped with Scout Armour or Phobos Armour can be equipped with a Camo Cloak. Enemy models making Ranged attacks against a model equipped with a Camo Cloak reduce their Ballistic Skill by 1 whilst the model equipped with a Camo Cloak is wholly positioned within a Terrain Feature.
wargearItems.effectsHtml: Models equipped with Scout Armour or Phobos Armour can be equipped with a Camo Cloak. Enemy models making Ranged attacks against a model equipped with a Camo Cloak reduce their Ballistic Skill by 1 whilst the model equipped with a Camo Cloak is wholly positioned within a Terrain Feature.

wargearItems.name: Iron Halo
effects: Increases its Toughness characteristic by 2 against Ranged attacks
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
The bearer:

  • Increases its Toughness characteristic by 2 against Ranged attacks
  • Gains the Invulnerable Save 4+ ability.

wargearItems.name: Rosarius
effects: Increase its Toughness characteristic by 2 against Ranged attacks
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
The bearer:

  • Increase its Toughness characteristic by 2 against Ranged attacks
  • Gains the Invulnerable Save 4+ ability.

wargearItems.name: Storm Shield
effects: Reduces the Armour Piercing characteristic of attacks against the bearer by 1 (to a minimum of 0)
Reduces the Damage characteristic of attacks against the bearer by 1 (to a minimum of 1)
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
The bearer:

  • Increases its Wounds characteristic by 2
  • Reduces the Armour Piercing characteristic of attacks against the bearer by 1 (to a minimum of 0)
  • Reduces the Damage characteristic of attacks against the bearer by 1 (to a minimum of 1)
  • Cannot possess the Mounted keyword.
  • Cannot possess the Phobos keyword.

wargearItems.name: Relic Weapon
effects: Grenade weapons cannot select this upgrade
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
• Increase weapon's Attacks characteristic by 1
  • Increase weapon's Strength characteristic by 1
  • Increase weapon's Damage characteristic by 1
  • Grenade weapons cannot select this upgrade

wargearItems.name: Combi-Bolter
effects: The bearer is equipped with a Boltgun
The bearer must be equipped with 1 of the following:
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
The bearer is equipped with a Boltgun

The bearer must be equipped with 1 of the following:

Flamer

Meltagun

Plasma Gun

wargearItems.name: Chapter Banner
effects: Friendly Adeptus Astartes units that can draw line of sight to the bearer, and who have at least 1 model within 18" of that model, change their Leadership characteristic to 2+.
While the bearer is on the battlefield and positioned wholly within range of a Primary Objective Marker, it is considered to have an Objective Control value of 30.
Models equipped with Phobos Armour cannot be equipped with a Chapter Banner.
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
• Friendly Adeptus Astartes units that can draw line of sight to the bearer, and who have at least 1 model within 18" of that model, change their Leadership characteristic to 2+.
  • While the bearer is on the battlefield and positioned wholly within range of a Primary Objective Marker, it is considered to have an Objective Control value of 30.
  • Models equipped with Phobos Armour cannot be equipped with a Chapter Banner.

wargearItems.name: Hero's Heraldry Banner
effects: Increases the Leadership characteristic of any other units with models wholly within 6" of this model to 3+.
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
The bearer:

  • Increases its Leadership characteristic to 3+
  • Increases the Leadership characteristic of any other units with models wholly within 6" of this model to 3+.

wargearItems.name: Auspex Scanner
effects: Units equipped with an Auspex Scanner:
Ignore the effects of the Stealth ability when making Ranged attacks against units with at least 1 model within 18" that possess that ability.
Cannot have enemy models placed within 12" of a model in this unit when that enemy unit uses the Enter the Battlefield from Strategic Reserves Action using the Deep Strike ability.
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
Units equipped with an Auspex Scanner:

  • Ignore the effects of the Stealth ability when making Ranged attacks against units with at least 1 model within 18" that possess that ability.
  • Cannot have enemy models placed within 12" of a model in this unit when that enemy unit uses the Enter the Battlefield from Strategic Reserves Action using the Deep Strike ability.

wargearItems.name: Twin-linked
effects: For weapons or Weapon Attack Profiles with a Strength characteristic of 7 or less, increase the Attacks characteristic by 3
For weapons or Weapon Attack Profiles with a Strength characteristic of 8 or more, increase the Attacks characteristic by 1
The Twin-Linked upgrade doubles the points cost of the weapon being upgraded.
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
Weapon gains the Twin-linked ability:

  • For weapons or Weapon Attack Profiles with a Strength characteristic of 7 or less, increase the Attacks characteristic by 3
  • For weapons or Weapon Attack Profiles with a Strength characteristic of 8 or more, increase the Attacks characteristic by 1

The Twin-Linked upgrade doubles the points cost of the weapon being upgraded.

wargearItems.name: Dozer Blade Mount
effects: Is equipped with a Dozer Blade
Improves their Breach Test roll by 1
Does not reduce their Movement characteristic by 2" when moving through Difficult Ground
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
The bearer:

  • Is equipped with a Dozer Blade
  • Improves their Breach Test roll by 1
  • Does not reduce their Movement characteristic by 2" when moving through Difficult Ground

wargearItems.name: Smoke Launchers
effects: The bearer can make 2 Smoke Grenades attacks as part of a Shoot action.
wargearItems.effectsHtml: The bearer can make 2 Smoke Grenades attacks as part of a Shoot action.

wargearItems.name: Shield Dome
effects: Models equipped with a Shield Dome increase their Toughness characteristic by 2 and gain the Invulnerable Save 5+ ability against Ranged Attacks.
wargearItems.effectsHtml: Models equipped with a Shield Dome increase their Toughness characteristic by 2 and gain the Invulnerable Save 5+ ability against Ranged Attacks.

wargearItems.name: Orbital Comms Array
effects: Models equipped with an Orbital Comms Array allow friendly Adeptus Astartes units within 6" of this model to ignore the effects of the Stealth ability when making Ranged attacks against units that possess that ability.
wargearItems.effectsHtml: Models equipped with an Orbital Comms Array allow friendly Adeptus Astartes units within 6" of this model to ignore the effects of the Stealth ability when making Ranged attacks against units that possess that ability.

wargearItems.name: Executioner Turret
effects: Models equipped with an Executioner Turret change the model's Transport 12 ability to Transport 6.
Models equipped with an Executioner Turret must be equipped with 1 of the following:
1x Macro Plasma Cannon and Onslaught Cannon
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
Models equipped with an Executioner Turret change the model's Transport 12 ability to Transport 6.

Models equipped with an Executioner Turret must be equipped with 1 of the following:

1x Macro Plasma Cannon and Onslaught Cannon

1x Laser Destroyer and Onslaught Cannon
